sharedItems.name: The Torn Letter

sharedItems.name: The Shield-Boss Stone

sharedItems.name: The Silver Brooch
sharedItems.text: We found it in the old ruins under the town. Nobody knows what it is for yet.

sharedItems.name: The Old Music Box

quests.name: Queen Stars
quests.text: Deep under our town, a queen made of stone opened her eyes. We named her Queen Stars. We asked her lots and lots of questions.

quests.name: The Moon Waits for the Sun
quests.text: Our family crest has a moon and a sun. We found the moon part. Where is the sun part? Queen Stars has not told us yet.

quests.name: Seek the Forgotten Strongholds
quests.text: Mom said do not follow her. Find the old strongholds of our people instead.

quests.name: The Sealed Path
quests.text: Silas's old map shows a high mountain pass marked with our crest. The elders say to stay away. Why?

quests.name: Tell Bree the Good News
quests.text: We forgave Ameelea for being a bully. Now we have to tell Bree that she is invited to Ameelea's fort.

quests.name: Keep Bree Safe
quests.text: Bree is hiding at Moira's. She owes us a favor.

people.name: Odbert
people.text: He runs the Block and Tackle, a cozy tavern and shop. Mom left a secret box with him to keep safe. We saved Roger there two times, so Odbert treats us like royalty!

people.name: Moira
people.text: A sweet gnome who makes magic potions. Behind her shop is a safe, hidden home for kids whose magic woke up too soon. She gave us our first spells and told us about the Moon-Stone.

people.name: Bree
people.text: A girl our age with magic fire. Some bullies made her so sad that flames burst out. We helped her calm down. Now she hides safe at Moira's, and she owes us a favor.

people.name: The Sheriff
people.text: He keeps our town safe. He is stern but fair. He paid us gold and gems for helping fix the town after the fire.

people.name: Elara
people.text: She runs the Hearth and Honey Bakery. She thinks every hero is far too skinny!

people.name: Old Man Grimma
people.text: He runs the Shattered Potion shop. We chased looters away from it. He is extra fond of Rainbow because she heals people. His special potion is called Hypulation!

people.name: Bill and AJ
people.text: Bill is the miller, and AJ is his wife. We met them while fixing up the town, and we gave their mill its name. It is WaterPour Mill!

people.name: Old Fishy
people.text: The oldest sailor in town. He says he once caught a giant rainbow jellyfish with a narwhal horn. Do you believe him?

people.name: Ella
people.text: She is the boss of the kids who run errands in the Market Square. The butcher pays them the best!

people.name: Ameelea
people.text: She was one of the kids who bullied Bree. She felt truly sorry, so we forgave her. Now Bree is invited to her fort.

people.name: Pippa
people.text: She works at the Archives. She talks super fast and her papers go everywhere. We sorted her filing, and she let us go down to the old vault.

people.name: Perriglossa
people.text: A knight who guarded the old ruins for a very, very long time. Dark magic had hold of her until our last hit knocked it out. Now she comes with us.

people.name: Suzie
people.text: A knight of the old ruins. She loves us, and she cannot stop hiccuping and burping!

people.name: Lima Protector
people.text: A knight of the old ruins. She only ever says one thing: "My name is Lima Protector, long ago I made an oath to protect the Limas, that is why my name is Lima Protector."

people.name: Queen Stars
people.text: A queen made of stone. She opened her eyes when we lifted the Moon-Stone, and we named her Queen Stars. She said Rainbow's staff reminds her of the magic tools of long ago. Everything else, she says, will come later.

journal.title: We Are the Lima Sisters
journal.text: We cleared the rats out of Odbert's basement, saved Roger, and followed the tunnels down into a huge cave. A treasure chest there held two magic rings. We put them on and they glowed. We are sisters of the Lima Clan! Deeper in we found a letter from Mom. She is alive and she is leading a bad man far away to keep us safe. A shiny stone lit up the wall and showed our family long ago, with a dark shadow watching them. Its name is the Eclipse.

journal.title: Odbert's Secret Box
journal.text: We looked around town and stopped at Odbert's shop. His old money box had our clan sign painted on the lid. It had a secret bottom! Inside was an old book about shadow monsters and a torn letter from Mom. Odbert said Mom left the box with him a long time ago to keep it safe.

journal.title: The Fire in Rivenshore
journal.text: Fires broke out all over town but we put them out. We saved Roger again, this time from under a falling light. Poor Roger! We kept Bree safe at Moira's sanctuary. Moira gave us our first spell cards. Rainbow got Crescent Moon Shield and Sky-Saver got Meteor Strike!

journal.title: The Door Under the Town
journal.text: We practiced our new spells and helped fix up the whole town. The sheriff paid us in gold and shiny gems. Then Rainbow Fairy chose Rainbow and Starry the star-kitten chose Sky-Saver. At tea Moira showed us a torn paper about the Moon-Stone. Our prism made secret words appear on it. Pippa at the Archives let us go down to the old vault. Sky-Saver put her sun-jewel in the door and it opened one inch. Cold air came out and we could hear music far below!

journal.title: The Knights Who Waited
journal.text: We went down the mossy stairs into old ruins under the town. We found a shiny silver brooch tucked in a wall. Then we came to a huge hall with our family crest on it. Three knight ladies were still guarding it after all this time. Two of them saw our rings and knelt right down. The third one had dark magic on her, so we had to fight. Our very last hit knocked the dark magic out of her and healed her! Her name is Perriglossa and now she comes with us. We camped inside a ring of glowing Star-Seed briars. A music box had played for us the whole way down, and when we picked it up it finally stopped. It was waiting for its owners to come home! Then we lifted the Moon-Stone together, four hands at once. A stone queen on the wall opened her eyes!

journal.title: Queen Stars
journal.text: The stone queen was awake, and she could talk! We gave her a name. She is Queen Stars. Then we asked her question after question. What was her life like? Why did she turn to stone? Does she know our mom? Why is Sky-Saver's sword made of clouds? She looked at Rainbow's staff and said it reminded her of the magic tools of long ago. For everything else she said, "Later." We cannot wait for later!
